services.equipment_note: Su equipo insignia es un aro de ducha tipo 'halo' (halo water therapy) en tonos rosa-dorado con iluminacion ambiental de color, mencionado explicitamente en sus propios captions de Instagram ('halo water therapy flowing'). Aparece consistentemente en las fotos de Booksy e Instagram, confirmando que es real y unico del local (no generico).

reviews.name: Luisa T.
reviews.text: @pinned_byjovie gave me such an amazing head spa experience from start to finish! The entire session was incredibly relaxing, soothing, and exactly what I needed to unwind and de-stress. She was so professional, attentive, and made sure I felt comfortable the whole time. The atmosphere was peaceful, the products felt amazing, and the scalp massage was absolutely heavenly. I left feeling refreshed, rejuvenated, and so pampered. You can truly tell she puts care and passion into what she does. I would definitely recommend her to anyone looking for a relaxing self-care experience. I can't wait to book again!

reviews.name: Zuleyca R.
reviews.text: If you're looking for a self-care experience, this is it! The head spa treatment was beyond relaxing and so professional. Jovie did an awesome job! I left feeling refreshed, stress-free, and my hair looked amazing afterward. Highly recommend supporting this business!

reviews.name: Megan C.
reviews.text: What an amazing experience. From the atmosphere to the relaxing service itself. I have never felt as relaxed then when I was with Jovi. This experience was just fantastic from start to finish. I recommend to anyone curious or has been to a head spa. This is the place to relax and reset yourself.

reviews_note: Booksy tiene 14 resenas en total, todas 5 estrellas. Se extrajeron 3 verbatim completas del JSON-LD (las unicas 3 que Booksy expone integras en el schema de la pagina publica); el resto solo aparecen truncadas/parafraseadas en el render de la pagina y no se usaron como cita literal para evitar inventar texto.

brand_vibe.description: Logo real (Booksy 'logo' y hialeahheadspa.com): wordmark 'Hialeah' en script con gradiente teal-azul-violeta-magenta sobre fondo negro, con 'HEAD SPA / HAIR.BODY.SPA' en blanco y un ilustracion lineal de cabello/silueta femenina con una media luna arriba (motivo celestial). Las fotos reales del tratamiento insignia (aro de ducha 'halo') muestran iluminacion ambiental en tonos purpura, azul, verde y rosa con herraje rosa-dorado/champagne. Resultado: estetica nocturna, mistica-celestial y editorial, con acento calido rosa-dorado sobre base oscura casi negra. NO es un spa boho/pastel; es moody y premium.
brand_vibe.palette_name: hialeahheadspa (negro violaceo celestial + rosa-dorado + violeta suave, paleta nueva)

language_evidence: hialeahheadspa.com (su propio sitio, la comunicacion mas deliberada del negocio) esta 100% en ingles. La descripcion oficial en Booksy esta en ingles. Las 3 resenas verbatim disponibles estan en ingles. Los captions de Instagram son mayoritariamente en ingles con palabras sueltas en espanol insertadas ("Relax. Refresh. Respira", bio con "Reserva tu momento de paz"), un patron de Spanglish de marketing tipico de Hialeah, pero no espanol como idioma principal de redaccion. Se usa 'en' como idioma por defecto del sitio, con toggle ES disponible igual (mercado bilingue).
